review_evidence: The source defines dimension-indexed neural-network components including Dense, AttentionHead, MultiHeadAttention, matmul, softmax, layer normalization, finite differences, and tensor/vector infrastructure.
lean/LinearAlgebra/Vector.lean defines a length-indexed Vector structure and more than twenty explicit theorems, including get_set_eq, get_map, get_push, get_zipWith, and ext.

Those proofs establish index/shape invariants and extensional behavior used by the typed implementation, so the repository contains reusable formal specifications and proofs rather than only unverified executable code.
summary: Retain llm.lean: alongside typed neural-network layers it contains a reusable dependent Vector development with a nontrivial theorem API.
